results.title: Harin sojan Ethiopia ya kashe mutum 25 a Amhara
results.content: Akalla mutum 25 sun mutu ciki har da yara kanana a wasu hare hare ta sama da aka kai a arewacin ƙasar Ethiopia kamar yadda majiyoyin lafiya suka kwarmatawa kamfanin dillancin labaran AFP

results.title: Kurdawa na samun nasara a kan mayakan ISIS a Syria
results.content: Dubban yan gudun hijira na ci gaba da tserewa fadan da ake tabkawa tsakanin Kurdawa da mayakan Jihadin kungiyar Isis a kasar Syriya al'amarin da ya haifar da kwararar 'yan gudun hijira a kasar Turkiya.

results.title: An samu raguwar kona motoci a bikin sabuwar shekara a Faransa
results.content: Gwamnatin Faransa tace an samu raguwar yawan adadin motocin da ake konewa a lokacin bikin sabuwar shekara da kashi 12 cikin 100 a cikin kasar. alkalumma sun nuna cewa a jajibirin sabuwar shekara an kone motoci 940 sabanin 1,067, da aka cinna wa wuta a shekarar da ta gabata.

results.title: Kotun Duniya ta bukaci Afirka ta Kudu ta cafke El-Bashir

results.title: An cafke mutane da dama kan zargin juyin mulki a Gambia
results.content: An cafke mutane da dama, da ake zargi suna da hannu a yunkurin jurin juyin mulkin da aka yi a kasar Gambia, lokacin da shugaban kasa Yahya Jammeh ke ziyara a birnin Dubai, wanda kuma ya dora alhakin harin kan ‘yan kasashen waje da bai bayyana sunayen su ba.

results.content: A yau lahadi ake buda taron shugabannin kasashen kungiyar Tarayyar Afirka karo na 25 a birnin Jonnesburg na kasar Afirka ta Kudu, taron da zai mayar da hankali kan batutuwa da dama da suka shafi kasashen nahiyar.

results.title: Jami’an Italiya sun yi kokarin ceto jirgin ruwan Bakin haure
results.content: Jami’an kula da jiragen ruwa a kasar Italiya sun nasarar ceto wani jirgin ruwa da ya samu matsala a tsakiyar teku shake da bakin haure kimanin 450 bayan sun yi nasarar ceto rayuwan bakin haure da dama a cikin kwanaki biyu da suka gabata.

results.title: Kotu ba ta amince da tsige shugaba Rajoanarimampianina ba
results.content: Kotun kolin kasar Madagascar ta yi watsi da matakin tsige shugaban kasar Hery Rajoana-rimampianina da majalisar dokokin kasar ta yi a ranar 26 ga watan jiya.

results.title: An sake zabar Netanyahu a matsayin shugaban Jam’iyya mai mulki
results.content: An sake zabar Fraiministan kasar Isra’ila Benjamin Netanyahu, a matsayin shugaban jam’iyyar Likud mai mulkin kasar, a wani zaben fitar da gwanin da aka yi jiya Alhamis. Zaben na zuwa ne a daidai lokacin da ake shirin yin wani zaben gaggawa a kasar, inda ya kayar da abokin takarar shi Danny Danon mai ra’ayin gurguzu.

results.title: Sake kaiwa Iran hari daga Amurka,babban kuskure ne da zai shafi duniya - Mojtaba
results.content: Jagoran Addinin musulunci na Iran, Mojtaba Khamenei,a yau asabar ya na mai gargadi ga Amurka na cewa ka da ta kuskura ta sake kai hari ga ƙasar ta Iran.Jagoran Addinin Iran, Mojtaba Khamenei,a yau asabar ya na mai gargadi ga Amurka na cewa ka da ta kuskura ta sake kai hari ga ƙasar Iran.

results.title: Sarkozy ya soki kawance da ke fada da mayakan IS
results.content: Tsohon shugaban Faransa Nicolas Sarkozy ya yi kakkausar ga kawancen dakarun kasashen duniya a karkashin jagorancin Amurka, dangane da yadda ya kasa murkushe mayakan da ke da’awar jihadi a kasashen Syria da Iraki.

results.title: Masu noman rani na fuskantar ƙalubale a jihar Maraɗi sakamakon karancin man fetur
results.content: Jamhuriyar Nijar, inda noman rani ranin ke fuskantar ƙalubale musamman a jihar Maraɗi, sakamakon karancin man fetur da kuma tsadarsa, lamarin da ya tilasta wa manoma dakatar da ayyukansu.

results.title: Hillary na gudanar da yakin neman zaben shugabancin Amurka
results.content: Tsohuwar sakatariyar harkokin wajen Amurka Hillary Clinton ta kaddamar da yakin neman zabenta na neman tsayawa takarar shugabancin Amurka a jiya asabar, inda ta ce tana fatar kasancewar mace ta farko da za ta jagoranci kasar a tarihi.

results.title: Ƙwararru na jan hankalin mahukuntan Najeriya kan karɓar basuka daga waje
results.content: Shirin Duniyarmu a Yau na wannan makon zai karkata ne zuwa ga fannin tattalin arziƙi a Najeriya, inda ƙwararru ke jan hankalin mahukuntan ƙasar kan a riƙa sara ana duban bakin gatari dangane da yadda gwamnati ke karɓar basuka musamman daga ƙetare.Wannan gargaɗi a baya bayan nan, ya biyo bayan, ɓullar labarin cewa shugaban Najeriya Bola Ahmed Tinubu ya buƙaci majalisar Dattijai, da ta amincewa da shirin gwamnati na karɓar bashin da ya kai Dala Biliyan 21.

results.title: RFI Hausa zai sauya Shafinsa na Intanet
results.content: Daga 15 ga watan Yuni, hausa.rfi.fr, shafin Intanet na RFI Hausa zai sauya sabuwar fuska, mai bayar da muhimmanci kan salon yada labarai irin na rediyo da hotunan bidiyo.

results.title: Bikin farfado da martabar rubuce-rubuce a jihar Kano
results.content: A cikin shirin nishadi daga sashen hausa na Rfi,an gudanar da bikin farfado da martabar rubuce-rubuce a jihar Kano,baya ga haka a cikin wannan shirin Hawa Kabir ta samu zantawa da wasu daga cikin masu ruwa da tsaki a duniyar Fina-finai.

results.title: An killace mutane biyu saboda Ebola a arewacin Najeriya
results.content: A Najeriya,cibiyar Kula da Cututtuka da Rigakafi ta ƙasa (NCDC) ta ba da rahoton gano mutane biyu da ake kyautata zaton sun kamu da kwayar cutar Bundibugyo cutar Ebola a yankin Arewa maso gabashin ƙasar.

results.title: Watanni biyu babu labarin ɗan jarida Moussa Kaka a jamhuriyar Nijar
results.content: A yau asabar aka cika watanni biyu babu labarin Moussa Kaka ɗan jaridar a jamhuriyar Nijar.A ranar 31 ga watan Agusta, Moussa Kaka ya bar ofisoshinsa na gidan rediyo da talabijen na Sarrauniya zuwa gida ne aka yi awon gaba da shi.

results.title: Lula da Silva zai halarci taron sauyin yanayi na COP31 a Turkiya
results.content: Fadar shugaban ƙasar Brazil a yau asabar ta sanar da cewa Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva zai halarci taron sauyin yanayi na COP31 na Majalisar Dinkin Duniya, wanda za a gudanar daga 9 zuwa 20 ga Nuwamba a Antalya, Turkiya.

results.title: Akalla mutum 11 sun mutu a wani harin da Lakurawa suka kai jihar Kebbi
results.content: Wasu ƴan ta’adda da ake zargin Lakurawa ne ko Mamudawa sun kai hari a wasu ƙauyuka da dama na jihar Kebbi da ke arewa maso yammacin Najeriya inda suka kashe wani jami’in ɗan sanda tare da fararen hula 11.

results.title: Chadi da Nijar na fatan kawo karshen rikici da ke tsakaninsu - Kogri
results.content: Ministocin harkokin wajen Chadi da Nijar sun gana a gefen taron kolin Rasha da Afirka da aka yi a Moscow,a jiya juma’a da nufin kawo karshen rikici da ke tsakanin ƙasashen biyu.

results.title: Obasanjo ya soki Tinubu kan ci gaba da ciwo bashi wanda kan iya lalata makomar ƙasar
results.content: Tsohon Shugaban kasa Olusegun Obasanjo ya soki gwamnatin Bola Tinubu kan ci gaba da neman lamuni na cikin gida da na waje domin tallafawa kasafin kudin kasa da kuma aiwatar da ayyuka a sassa daban-daban.

results.title: Yau ake buɗe gasar Olympics ta matasa a ƙasar Senegal
results.content: Da yammacin wannan asabar ne Senegal za ta karbi bakunci gasar Olympics na matasa ta bazara 2026.

results.title: Domin kaucewa tarzoma, Jamus ta aike da karin jami’an tsaro a faɗin ƙasar
results.content: A hukumomi a Jamus sun aike da karin jami’an tsaro a faɗin ƙasar,a wani mataki na kaucewa tarzoma da kan iya biyo bayan zanga-zanga da ake sa ran matasa da dama za su kasancewa a wannan ƙasa a yau asabar.
